current_version.description: The document's version now: later than version when it was changed and posted again since.

document_type.description: The document's type, when the source is a document; absent otherwise.

id.description: The source's ID, to open it.

link.description: Where the document opens in the web app, when it has a page.

number.description: The document's number, once it has one.

party.description: The customer's or supplier's name, for a document that names one.

type.description: The source type (ENG-03), such as manual_journal, bill or bank_transaction.

version.description: The source's version that posted the entry.
